item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsungs 'bum las dkar mo srid rgyal gyi gdams pa
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam nyams snang 'di/ gar (dkar) chag yi ger btab pa yang / yi dam lha la mthol lo bshag bla ma rje la bzod par gsol/ ma sring gnyen mo'i tshogs rnams dang / bka' skyongs dbal mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ dbying (dbyings) nas bka' chad mi gtong 'tshal/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams tshogs/ bdag sogs phyi rabs gang zag rnams/ mthun rkyen phun sum 'tshogs pa dang / 'gal rkyen bar chod med par shog bod yul kha ba can ljon du (ljongs su)/ bstan pa dar rgyas brtan pa dang / bon gyi rgyal srid 'dzug par shog phyog (phyogs) dang dus rnams thams cad du/ sems can bde skyid 'dzom pa dang*/ bkra shis smon lam brtsan pa shog/
